title: How to organise the sofa and seating zone | Living Room
description:
Somewhere every person in the house can sit down without first moving something.

This is the Sofa and Seating Zone in the Living Room. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Every seat on the sofa and every armchair is sittable without lifting a single thing off it. Throws folded to one size in one basket, at most one cushion per seat left in place, and both remotes in the tray on the arm with batteries that work.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Pull everything off the seats and dig the seams out: the laundry that migrated here, the second and third thro
Straighten: The remotes get one tray, and it goes on the arm people actually reach from while sitting, not the arm nearest
Shine: Vacuum the seams and the deck under the cushions with the upholstery tool, then wipe the arms and the headrest
Safety: Check the recliner footrest and the sofa bed hinge, and make it a rule that both close slowly with a look at t
Standardize: Put the rule on the basket label itself: throws folded into the basket, nothing stored on a seat.
Sustain: The last person out of the room at night squares the cushions and drops the throws in the basket.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Seats hold people, not storage.
